messages:
Nina: idea: make the next webinar a hands-on workshop + mini 'certification' sticker. attendees choose a lane (latency / cost / quality), complete a short lab, and get a badge. purpose: more post-webinar engagement and clear routing for follow-ups. feedback?

Elaine: huge yes. the badges are a nice growth hook. keep it tight: 70 minutes total. 10m framing, 40m labs, 15m capstones, 5m wrap.

Sanju: infra callout: ephemeral sandboxes + per-sandbox token caps are mandatory. recommend provisioning a pool of 16 sandboxes in staging, each with token_quota=2500 and ttl=70m. will provide a one-line CLI for attendees to paste.

Sanju: example attendee CLI (we'll provide exact copy in onboarding):
redwoodctl sandbox create --model redwood-13b-q4 --ttl 70m --token-quota 2500 --label workshop-2026

Leah: lead routing: capture lane, badge earned (yes/no), infra interest (hosted|dedicated|private), and product maturity signal (P0: evaluating, P1: pilot, P2: production). route P2 + dedicated interest to AE queue; others to nurture. also add a checkbox for wanting a trial.

Leah: suggested form fields: email, company, lane, infra_interest, maturity, trial_opt_in, consent. we'll map to HubSpot properties and set a list for follow-up sequences.

Owen: UX note: onboarding needs a 3-step checklist in the confirmation email: 1) test audio/video, 2) run the one-line CLI to provision sandbox (we'll auto-create if they hit the link), 3) open lab guide. include a short troubleshooting faq.

Jess: speakers: quick framing by Elaine, infra walkthrough by Sanju, customer micro-case (5m) showing numbers, Owen to run live capstone moderation. i'll confirm two customers this week. abstracts limited to 2 short paras + 3 bullets.

Nina: rehearsal plan: single 35m run-through focused on onboarding flow + failover path, plus a 10m tech check the day of. we should prerecord a 2m failover clip (switch to hosted tiny model) and keep it ready.

Sanju: i'll provision the 16 sandboxes and publish a provisioning doc + an ops-runbook snippet that includes a global token ceiling and an emergency swap command for moderators.

Leah: i'll build the HubSpot mapping and the post-event micro-survey (one Q: which lane was most useful?). also propose a drip: day+1 'lab replay' with instructions to claim a trial tied to their chosen lane.

Owen: i'll draft the attendee checklist and the capstone judging rubric (3 quick criteria: reproducibility, cost delta, latency delta). short rubric helps judges keep time and give useful feedback.

Jess: i'll own speaker outreach and abstracts.

Sanju: i'll own sandbox provisioning and the failover command.

Leah: i'll own leads and automation.

Owen: i'll own attendee checklist + rubric.

Nina: i'll compile the ops playbook and attendee email copy. I'll aim to post the blurb today and slot rehearsals for next Wed.

deploy-bot: Notice: Inference pool maintenance scheduled 2026-05-02 02:00-02:30 UTC. Recommend avoiding that window for the workshop.

Nina: noted @deploy-bot 6a7 we'll avoid that window. everyone drop a one-line confirmation here so I can lock the checklist.
